channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: ‘Long-range sanctions’: Ukraine hopes strikes cause Russia fear and losses
item.description: Al Jazeera is given rare access to one of Ukraine's long-range drone units tasked with targeting Russia.

item.title: What’s behind Trump’s shift to economic pressure on Iran? Will it work?
item.description: Months into the war, Trump is returning to squeezing Iran's economy rather than military offensive for now.

item.title: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian drone attack on Russia’s Nizhnekamsk
item.description: A day of mourning has been declared in the Russian republic of Tatarstan after the attack killed 13 people.

item.title: How significant is Mohsen Rezaei’s appointment as Iran’s security chief?
item.description: Former IRGC commander Rezaei will be taking over as secretary of Iran's top security body amid Hormuz talks.

item.title: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian drone strike deep into Russia
item.description: Russian officials say another 75 people were injured by the attack in the Tatarstan region, one of the deadliest Ukrainian drone attacks on Russia since Moscow's full-scale invasion.

item.title: Alleged rebel leader killed in Colombia as president targets armed groups
item.description: The military operation against Hernando Forero Mosquera was carried out just days after Colombia's new president was sworn in.

item.title: Battle for Mali base has killed dozens of militants, army says
item.description: The army says it was involved in fierce fighting but disputes that Islamists took control of the garrison.

item.title: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza, Netanyahu says
item.description: Israel's PM says its military will not pull out from Gaza until Hamas is "genuinely" disarmed.
